subject: `use Test::More tests => N` emits NO `1..N` plan line — a TAP file no harness can judge
description:
Found by an s374 probe while working #236.

  perl:  use Test::More tests => 2; ok(1,"a"); ok(1,"b");   ->  1..2 / ok 1 / ok 2
  PCL :  same source                                        ->  ok 1 / ok 2   (NO plan line)
  PCL :  use Test::More; plan tests => 2; ...                ->  1..2 / ok 1 / ok 2  (correct)

So only the IMPORT-ARG spelling of the plan is dropped.  A TAP stream with no
plan and no `done_testing` is one a harness cannot judge — the #202 family
("a claim that cannot be evaluated must say so").  It has never shown in our
own measurements because sweep-perl-tests.pl counts rows itself rather than
reading the plan.

Where: cl/pcl-test.lisp's import handling (pl-plan is correct; the import path
never calls it).  Descriptions/plan lines are join keys for the skip-registry
and tools/sweep-diff.pl — check nothing keys off the ABSENCE of the line
before fixing.

Raised as ask 5.1 in docs/opus5-review-requests-s374.md.
activeForm: Filing the missing import-form TAP plan line
